official_source_observations.source_title: BitForex | Securities & Futures Commission of Hong Kong
official_source_observations.observed_facts: The SFC alert identifies BitForex and lists bitforex.com. It describes the platform as suspected of fraudulent activities and reports users were unable to access accounts or withdraw assets. Add date shown: 2024-03-04.
official_source_observations.interpretation_limit: This is an official warning and reported user-access issue, not a court judgment; it does not by itself determine the current operator, current site content, or a model label.

official_source_observations.observed_facts: The FCA page identifies Ai-MiningEx and aiminingex.com, states it is not FCA-authorised and may target UK consumers, and gives first-publication date 2025-05-23.
official_source_observations.interpretation_limit: The FCA warning is evidence about the named firm and UK authorisation status; it is not a conviction or an automatic label for all related domains or messages.

official_source_observations.observed_facts: The FCA page identifies Chainstackinvest.com and chainstackinvest.com, states it is not FCA-authorised and may target UK consumers, and gives first-publication date 2025-07-11.
official_source_observations.interpretation_limit: The FCA warning is not a conviction and does not establish the contents or operator of any particular communication.

official_source_observations.observed_facts: The FCA page identifies OPENTRADING PLATFORM and opentrading-platform.com, states it is not FCA-authorised and may target UK consumers, and gives first-publication date 2025-08-14.
official_source_observations.interpretation_limit: The warning supports a regulator-warning relationship, not a conviction or an automatic scam label.

official_source_observations.observed_facts: The AMF Québec page, published 2025-10-17, states PrimeWealth is not registered with the AMF and is not authorized to solicit investors in Québec. It lists primewealthltd.com and the names Prime Wealth and PrimeWealth Limited.
official_source_observations.interpretation_limit: This is a jurisdiction-specific registration/solicitation warning, not a court judgment or a label for unrelated entities.

official_source_observations.source_title: Public Alert: Trade Xtix Coins | SEC
official_source_observations.observed_facts: The SEC PAUSE page lists Trade Xtix Coins, the email domain tradextixcoins.com, and website tradextixcoins.com; the page is dated 2024-10-29 and explains the PAUSE list includes entities making false registration/licensing/location claims and impersonators.
official_source_observations.interpretation_limit: The page is an SEC public alert. It is not a criminal conviction and does not establish the content or operator of a specific subdomain or communication.
